    StartersThurman's toasted peanut butter and jamPeanut butter and strawberry jam sandwiches dipped in cinnamon egg and fried in butterHow to make it8 slices of thick white bread4 tbsp crunchy peanut butter4 tbsp strawberry jam2 eggs100ml milk1 pinch of ground cinnamon40g butter1 tbsp icing sugarMake 4 sandwiches from the thick white bread, with peanut butter on one slice and jam on the other.Whisk the eggs, milk and cinnamon.Dip each sandwich briefly on both sides.Fry in butter until golden on each side.Cut into triangles and dust with icing sugar.Mall food court pretzel dogsFrankfurts in soft dough dipped in bicarb water, baked dark with rock salt, mustard cheese dipHow to make itAs written, serves 4Frankfurts wrapped in soft pretzel dough, dipped in bicarb water and baked dark with rock salt, with a hot mustard and root beer cheese dip.Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour.Roll into 8 ropes and coil around 8 frankfurts.Dip in simmering water with 60g bicarb for 20 seconds, sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220°C for 15 minutes.Melt 150g grated cheddar into a sauce of 20g butter, 1 tbsp flour and 200ml root beer, plus 1 tsp hot mustard.Jalapeño cheese nachosCorn chips under melted cheddar, pickled jalapeños, sour cream and salsaHow to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsDiner roast turkey with stuffing and gravyBrined turkey breast, stuffing, mashed potatoes, gravy and cranberry sauceHow to make it1.5kg turkey breast4 tbsp salt, for the brine2 L water, for the brine1 packet of stuffing mix1kg potatoes, peeled60g butter500ml chicken stock2 tbsp plain flour1 jar of cranberry sauceStir the salt into the water until dissolved, then brine the turkey in it for 3 hours and pat dry.Roast at 170°C until it reaches 70°C inside.Bake the stuffing mix in a dish alongside.Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter.Make gravy from the pan juices, flour and stock.Serve with cranberry sauce.Arizona red chilli pork tamalesPork braised in red chilli, wrapped in masa and corn husk and steamed softHow to make itAs written, serves 4Masa beaten fluffy with lard and stock, wrapped around red chilli pork in corn husks, steamed tender, with salsa verde and crema.Simmer 800g pork shoulder until tender, about 2 hours, then shred.Blend 4 soaked dried guajillo chillies with garlic, cumin and 250ml stock, fry for 5 minutes and stir through the pork.Beat 150g lard until fluffy, then beat in 500g masa harina, 2 tsp baking powder, salt and 500ml warm stock.Spread on 16 soaked corn husks, fill, fold and steam upright for 75 minutes.Serve with salsa verde and sour cream.SweetsChristmas fruit cake slicesDense orange-soaked fruit cake with almonds, in the orange juice overnight.Cream the butter and sugar and beat in the eggs.Fold in the fruit, flour, spice and almonds.Bake in a lined tin at 150°C.Cool and slice thin.Advent calendar chocolatesDark and milk chocolate squares topped with toasted hazelnut or sea saltHow to make it150g dark chocolate150g milk chocolate12 hazelnuts, toasted1 pinch of sea saltMelt the dark and milk chocolate separately.Spoon into small squares on baking paper or an ice cube tray.Top half with a toasted hazelnut and half with sea salt.Set in the fridge.Line them up in a numbered fridge.Fill 4 tall glasses with ice.Add the cold tea and lime juice to each.Top with ginger beer and stir once.Add a lime wedge and a cinnamon stick.
